The form विदाङ्कुर्वन्तु is optionally employed as an irregular form.

Terms: आम्

The affix कुरच् comes in the sense of 'agent having such a habit etc.' after the verbs 1. विद् 'to know' 2. भिद् 'to divide' 3. छिद् 'to pierce'.

Terms: कुरच्

The above nine affixes of the लिट् (Perfect Tense) are optionally added in the लट् (Present Tense) also after the verb विद् 'to know'.

Terms: लिट् and लट्

The affix वुञ् comes in the sense of 'thence come' after a word denoting a person connected through the relationship or family origin.

Terms: वुञ्

The affix य comes in the sense of 'what manifests itself there' after the word विदुर।

Terms: य

वसु is substituted for the Present Participle affix शतृ after the root विद् 'to know'.

Terms: Some substitution
